description: A burst's variants the user can open, oldest first, each with its values of the burst's parameters or filters, how its latest run went, whether one is going, and who its email goes to. adding lists the variants the user is still adding. Answers up to limit variants, 50 by default and 200 at most, and a nextCursor: pass it as cursor for the next page, until it is null.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The burst to act on, by its `id` from `listBursts`. You can also copy it from the burst's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/collections/`.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

cursor.description: Where to continue the list: pass the `nextCursor` returned with the previous page to get the next one. Omit it for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of variants to return on this page, from 1 to 200. Defaults to `50`.

name: listBurstVariants
title: List burst variants
